title: ctenitis subglandulosa
intro: Ctenitis subglandulosa, commonly known as the Fern, is a plant species in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the subfamily Dryopteridoideae. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include various health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, contributing to its therapeutic actions in treating conditions like fever and infections. Ctenitis subglandulosa contains bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
